exam_facts.test: Heart normal rate, regular rhythm, no murmurs.
Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally, no wheezes, rales, or rhonchi.
Mental status alert and oriented to person, place, time, and situation.
Normal strength and tone in all extremities.

exam_facts.result: 98% at rest, no desaturation during Valsalva or post-micturition monitoring

exam_facts.test: Orthostatic blood pressure and heart rate
exam_facts.result: Supine: 130/85 mmHg, HR 72 bpm; standing at 1 min: 124/80 mmHg, HR 76 bpm; no drop ≥20 mmHg systolic or ≥10 mmHg diastolic, no HR increase >30 bpm
Hemoglobin 14.2 g/dL, hematocrit 42.1%, WBC 6.3 × 10³/μL, platelets 228 × 10³/μL, differential within normal limits
Color pale yellow, clarity clear, specific gravity 1.012, pH 6.0, no glucose, no protein, no blood, no leukocyte esterase, no nitrites, 0–1 WBC/hpf, 0 RBC/hpf, no casts or crystals

exam_facts.test: Prothrombin time (PT) and activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT)

exam_facts.result: No acute intracranial hemorrhage, infarction, mass effect, or structural abnormality; ventricles symmetric and normal in size; basal cisterns patent; no evidence of hydrocephalus or posterior fossa compression

Left ventricular ejection fraction 62%, no regional wall motion abnormalities, no valvular stenosis or regurgitation > trace, no left ventricular outflow tract obstruction, no intracardiac shunt, no apical hypertrophy or septal thickening, aortic root diameter 3.1 cm

Sinus rhythm throughout, average heart rate 68 bpm, minimum 49 bpm (no pause >3.0 sec), maximum 112 bpm, no supraventricular or ventricular tachyarrhythmias, no atrioventricular block beyond first-degree (PR interval max 208 ms), no ventricular pauses attributable to bradycardia or asystole

exam_facts.test: EEG (awake and drowsy, with photic stimulation and hyperventilation)
exam_facts.result: Normal background rhythm (dominant 8–10 Hz alpha activity posteriorly, reactive to eye opening), no epileptiform discharges, no focal or generalized slowing, no paroxysmal activity before, during, or after hyperventilation

Bilateral common, internal, and external carotid arteries patent with no stenosis >10%; peak systolic velocity <125 cm/sec in internal carotids; no plaque or ulceration; vertebral arteries patent and antegrade
Normal alignment, no cord compression or signal abnormality, no disc herniation impinging neural foramina or spinal canal, no myelomalacia or syrinx, C1–C7 vertebral bodies and discs preserved

Liver echotexture homogeneous, size normal (right lobe 14.2 cm), no focal lesions; gallbladder without stones or wall thickening; kidneys symmetric (right 10.8 cm, left 11.0 cm), corticomedullary differentiation preserved, no hydronephrosis or masses; bladder wall normal thickness, post-void residual volume 25 mL; prostate 28 g, homogeneous, no nodules
